name: ToothFairy
notes: MICCAI 2023 challenge (inferior alveolar canal). License stated only on toothfairy.grand-challenge.org. Test set private.

name: ToothFairy2
notes: MICCAI 2024 challenge; 42 classes. Reuses ToothFairy volumes plus 63 new. License stated only on toothfairy2.grand-challenge.org. 50 hidden test volumes.

name: ToothFairy3
notes: ODIN 2025 at MICCAI 2025; 77 classes. Reuses ToothFairy2 volumes plus 52 new. Paper DOI not yet found (link is UNIMORE repository). 50 hidden test volumes.

name: ToothFairy4
notes: ODIN 2026 at MICCAI 2026; CBCT-to-report generation. Italian reports with LLM-translated English. Size conflict: page states 625 but subsets sum to 632 and ODIN page says 630. No dataset paper found.

name: AlphaDent
notes: Also on Kaggle / Hugging Face / GitHub; Hugging Face lists Apache-2.0. Paper counts inconsistent (abstract: over 1200; methods: 1320 + 135 test).

name: SMART-OM
notes: Smartphone photos of oral mucosa from 331 subjects; classes include OPMD and oral cancer.

name: Bite2Text
data_type: 3D intraoral scan + 2D intraoral photo + text report
notes: ECCV 2026; ODIN 2026 Task 2. No DOI/arXiv found (link is author page). Paper text says CC BY-SA 4.0.

name: CariesXrays
notes: Data on a personal Google Drive linked from the repo. No license stated. Not the same as CariXray.

name: OralXrays-9
notes: Password-protected zips on Google Drive; password is in the repo README but the Drive README says to contact the authors. No license stated.

name: DENTEX
notes: MICCAI 2023 challenge; same data as HierarchicalDet. 1571 images unlabeled. Zenodo copy lists CC-BY-4.0.

name: DenPAR
notes: Earlier Zenodo versions (2024) were restricted; first open release 2025.

name: PRAD
notes: Also called PRAD-10K: paper describes 10000 images but only 5000 are released. Apply by email. README badge shows CC BY-NC, which conflicts with the application terms.

name: CariXray
notes: Data on Google Drive; sign-in page shown on 2026-10-23. Size from abstract snippet only (paper paywalled). Not the same as CariesXrays.

name: Teeth3DS
notes: Also the MICCAI 2022 3DTeethSeg22 challenge dataset; 900 patients. Commercial use needs a separate license.

name: Teeth3DS+
notes: Extends Teeth3DS with landmarks for the MICCAI 2024 3DTeethLand challenge. OSF holds 100 extra landmark-test scans beyond the paper's 1800. License wording updated 2026-10-21.
